General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Transfer Case Breather Plug that inserts into the top of the Transfer case Assembly.
If you have noticed water getting into your Transfer case this is the most likely point.
Cheap to buy and Quick to install.
Replace your old one and extend the life of your Transfer case.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Transfer Case Breather Plug
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
